deploybot: Rollback initiated -> release tag v2.8.1 reverted to v2.8.0 on prod-west. Reason: canary spike 5xxs across routing layer. Rollback ID: rb-1770004321. Trigger: canary-health >= 3m failures. Commits involved: v2.8.1 -> tag: 876b2a4. Revert target tag: v2.8.0 (c3f1a9d). ETA: ~5m. Logs: https://internal.redwood.dev/logs/rollback/rb-1770004321 :rotating_light:

maria: ACK. Starting pin on routing for prod-west and eu-west. Will hold traffic to stable pool while infra inspects. @ajay can you verify there are no destructive db migrations in that tag?

ajay: I looked at the PR diff earlier, there is a non-destructive index addition but migration is additive and backwards-compatible. No rollback of DB needed. :white_check_mark:

liam: Preparing a hotfix branch `hotfix/repro-502` in case the underlying problem needs a patch. Will open PR and post link here. 

maria: Thanks. Pinning config now: `redwood pin set --env prod-west --tag v2.8.0 --reason "canary 502 spike" --note "auto-rollback by deploybot rb-1770004321"`

infra-bot: Pin applied to prod-west routing table. Pin ID: pin-666f. Cached backends drained for 45s. 

sara: Monitoring dashboards. Canary errors dropped immediately after drain started. tail of errors shows client side retries spiking earlier. Reference alert: alert-canary-502

ajay: Can we capture the failing request traces before we clear KV caches? If we need to reproduce, we should preserve traces for 24h. @maria

maria: Good call. I've triggered trace export: `infra export-traces --filter "env:prod-west AND tag:v2.8.1" --out s3://redwood-debug/rb-1770004321/traces`. ETA ~2m.

deploybot: Rollback completed. Duration: 3m54s. Status: SUCCESS. Services reverted to v2.8.0, routing pinned (pin-666f). No migrations rolled back. Post-rollback checks: smoke tests passed (10/10), latency within baseline. Audit log: https://internal.redwood.dev/audit/rb-1770004321

liam: Revert PR created to track changes and next deploy: https://github.com/redwood/repo/pull/2019 (branch: revert/v2.8.1). Adding test harness to reproduce the 502 in a staging canary.

sara: Observability confirms error budget not breached for prod-west after revert. Will keep a 30m watch and then lift canary hold if stable.

maria: Posting a short blurb in #announcements once we confirm 30m stability. Also adding release note in release tracker: `Release v2.8.1 - rolled back due to canary 502s; reverted to v2.8.0; follow-up PR #2019`.

ajay: I'll follow up with a postmortem draft in #postmortems and link the exported traces. Anyone who touched routing changes on v2.8.1 please @mention in that doc.

infra-bot: Reminder scheduled: auto-unpin after 4h if not manually extended. Use `redwood pin extend --id pin-666f --hours <n>` to change.

maria: Thanks everyone. Main action items: liam -> repro + PR, sara -> 30m watch + metrics snapshot, ajay -> postmortem draft, infra -> keep traces for 24h. Ping me if anything spikes.

ajay: acked. :thumbsup:
